channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Clover Hall Crescent, roadworks in Rochdale from 17 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Clover Hall Crescent in Rochdale; expected timings: 6am on Tuesday, 17 November 2026–11.59pm on Saturday, 21 November 2026.

item.title: Friend backs Springhill Hospice Christmas appeal after Leanne Field’s last Minions party
item.description: Sally Kerr is backing Springhill Hospice’s Christmas appeal in memory of her best friend Leanne Field, 45, who had one last party at the Rochdale hospice two days before she died.

item.title: Seven Sisters to be demolished as RBH plans around 600 new homes at College Bank
item.description: All seven College Bank tower blocks will come down, with a planning application for around 600 new homes expected in early 2027. RBH expects every remaining customer to have moved out by summer 2027.

item.title: Rochdale Boroughwide Housing to demolish Seven Sisters tower blocks due to high refurbishment costs
item.description: Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has decided to demolish the Seven Sisters tower blocks due to high refurbishment costs, with plans for new homes to follow.

item.title: Kyle Howard pleads guilty to murder of wife Keeley Aspinall in Rochdale
item.description: Kyle Howard, 37, of Tweedale Street, Rochdale, admitted murdering his wife Keeley Aspinall, 44, at Manchester Crown Court and will be sentenced on Wednesday 18 November.

item.title: Join for a Toy membership launched to support Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal
item.description: Your Trust Rochdale has launched a new membership initiative called Join for a Toy, aimed at supporting this year's Christmas Toy Appeal. The initiative encourages community members to donate suitable gifts for children and families in need across the borough during the festive season.

item.title: Plans for new Heywood fire station submitted to Rochdale Council
item.description: Greater Manchester Fire and Rescue Service has proposed a new fire station in Heywood, set to replace the existing facility on Middleton Road.

item.title: Why Rochdale says ‘cruckle’
item.description: ‘Cruckle’ is the local verb for rolling or twisting an ankle — an old dialect survival that Rochdale speakers still recognise as a hometown word.

item.title: Students trained as Rochdale Creative Health Advocates at Falinge Park High School
item.description: Students from various schools participated in training to become Creative Health Advocates, aimed at promoting health and wellbeing in the community.

item.title: Rochdale AFC youth team faces Bolton in U-17 PDL Cup
item.description: Rochdale AFC's youth team will compete against Bolton Wanderers in the U-17 PDL Cup on Tuesday, with kick-off scheduled for 2pm. This match marks the completion of Dale's group stage in the competition, providing an opportunity for the young players to showcase their skills against a strong opponent.

item.title: 215th anniversary of Rochdale statesman John Bright's birth celebrated
item.description: Today marks 215 years since the birth of John Bright, a key figure in free trade and abolitionism, who was born in Rochdale.

item.description: Rochdale Council has announced enhanced support for homeless individuals in the borough as winter temperatures begin to fall. The initiative aims to provide additional resources and assistance to those experiencing homelessness during the colder months. To combat the effects of severe weather, the council is closely monitoring temperatures and deploying…

item.title: Rochdale Business Awards 2026 winners announced, celebrating local achievements
item.description: Performance Doorset Solutions Ltd and Salt Separation Services Ltd were among the winners at the Rochdale Business Awards 2026, recognising local contributions to the economy.

item.title: Failsworth tram stop lifts out of service due to replacement works
item.description: Passengers at Failsworth tram stop face disruptions as lifts are out of service, affecting access to services towards Rochdale and East Didsbury.

item.title: M62 closed near Milnrow after lorry hits central reservation
item.description: The M62 was closed near junction 21 at Milnrow on Sunday afternoon after a lorry hit the central reservation, the Lancashire Telegraph reported.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Sunday 15 November 2026
item.description: 7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Gritters: when & where
item.description: Rochdale's seven gritters are back out on main roads, bus routes and school streets. Here is when they grit, which roads they cover and where to find a grit bin.

item.title: Buckley Hall Prison: drugs, self-harm and ‘requires improvement’
item.description: Rochdale’s category C prison is meant to send men home sober, skilled and steadier. Inspectors and monitors say drugs, lock-ups and thin education are getting in the way.

item.title: Hopwood Hall: DePree's appeal deadline nears after High Court defeat
item.description: Hopwood DePree has until Wednesday 18 November to seek permission to appeal. Who he is, how he came to Middleton's Hopwood Hall, why the council ended his deal, and what happens next.

item.title: Middleton Shopping Centre puts on Rochdale's best fireworks display
item.description: A huge display shot from the roof of Middleton Shopping Centre provided an unforgettable finale to the town's Christmas lights switch-on.

item.title: Heywood councillor apologises for Christmas lights switch-on after stray firework and 'mediocre' display
item.description: North Heywood councillor Bev Place has apologised after families said a stray firework went into the crowd at Heywood's Christmas lights switch-on, calling the display mediocre.

item.title: Animal charity serving Rochdale seeks stallholders for Christmas fairs
item.description: PAWS is inviting stallholders to apply for December events in Uppermill and Todmorden, supporting a rescue charity whose work includes Rochdale.

item.title: Rochdale manager Ian Watson questions goal line clearance after 1-0 defeat to York City
item.description: Rochdale manager Ian Watson described his team's 1-0 defeat to York City as 'really tough to take', questioning a key goal line clearance.

item.title: The Healey Dell prophecy: Eleanor Byron, Mother Bagden and what the records actually show
item.description: A centuries‑old tale that a Lady Eleanor would be “maid, wife and widow in one day” survives in Healey Dell’s visitor guides — but it begins with nineteenth‑century collectors, not medieval paperwork.

item.title: Laced vapes: what is in them, how they reach children, and how to report sellers
item.description: Vapes sold to children as cannabis oil are being found to contain spice, a far stronger synthetic drug that has put young people in hospital. Here is what is known and how to report sellers in Rochdale.

item.title: Warning issued over e-bikes and e-scooters ahead of Christmas
item.description: Police warn about the dangers of illegal e-bikes and e-scooters following a tragic incident involving a local teenager.

item.title: Heywood residents praised for Remembrance tributes on Armistice Day
item.description: Thousands gathered in Heywood and Rochdale to honour war heroes during the Remembrance Sunday and Armistice Day commemorations, with the Last Post and moments of silence.

item.title: Jamie Allen expresses love for Rochdale AFC after 150 appearances
item.description: Jamie Allen, who made over 150 appearances for Rochdale AFC, shares his affection for the club in a recent interview.

item.title: Measles: the symptoms to look out for in your child, and when to get help
item.description: More than 1,000 measles cases have been confirmed in England this year, 111 of them in the North West. Here is how the illness starts and the warning signs that need urgent care.

item.title: Rochdale IT provider offers solutions for email disruptions during Microsoft outages
item.description: Rochdale-based IT provider No Fuss IT has urged local businesses to consider alternative communication methods in light of recent Microsoft 365 outages that disrupted email services. The company, led by Finn O’Loughlin, highlighted the potential consequences of email disruptions, including unanswered customer inquiries and delayed purchase orders.

item.title: Rochdale’s own Stonehenge? What archaeologists actually know about the moorland stones
item.description: Surveys and excavations show Bronze Age cairns and widespread prehistoric flint scatters on the moors above Rochdale — but the idea of a local ‘Stonehenge’ is disputed and needs more professional study.

item.title: Christmas giving in Rochdale: the toy appeal, the foodbank and the mayor's charities
item.description: New, unwrapped toys for children aged up to 16 are needed by Friday 11 December, while Rochdale Foodbank is short of juice, rice, toothpaste and coffee.

item.title: Police search for man who helped woman after alleged sexual assault in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police are appealing for information regarding a man who assisted a woman following an alleged sexual assault in Rochdale town centre.

item.title: ILEARN International Limited to be wound up following resolutions

item.title: Sanderson's Floor & Roof Truss Company Limited enters liquidation
